messages:
Sam CSM: FYI Bluetrace onboarding hit a blocker — their security team needs a /22 subnet added to our allowlist for next week's demo and wants traffic to be routed through eu-west1 or asia-southeast1 depending on region. Can ops/infra help?
Li Ops: noted. do we have the exact subnet and scope?
Sam CSM: They provided 203.0.113.0/22 and asked that only inference endpoints in eu or apac see it. Also asked for a temporary rate increase for the demo: +3x token throughput for 48h starting 2026-06-03 09:00 UTC.
Marco Eng: @Sam CSM we need to confirm model variants allowed for that burst and fallback policy. If we route to eu/apac, are we pinned to the smaller 8xA100 pool or do they want dedicated?
Nina PM: Bluetrace is on an annual renewal Q3; positive demo is high impact but there's churn risk if latency issues persist. Recommend approving the temporary bump and observability cursors.
Ben Oncall: I can provision a temporary policy but need an approval ticket in #approvals and a clear rollback time. Also will add synthetic checks to measure p95 latency during the window.
Sam CSM: created approval ticket ENG-3492 with details and TTL. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3492 
Sam CSM: approval note: "Bluetrace - /22 allowlist 203.0.113.0/22; route inference requests from that subnet preferentially to region eu-west1, fallback asia-southeast1; rate window +300% from 2026-06-03T09:00Z to 2026-06-05T09:00Z. Temporary feature flag bluetrace_demo_flow=true. Rollback automatic at TTL."
infra-bot: Approval ticket ENG-3492 status changed to APPROVED by @Li Ops at 2026-05-26T16:12:03Z.
Li Ops: provisioning plan: 1) add subnet to tenant-level allowlist 2) attach region routing policy to Bluetrace account 3) create burst policy (rate_multiplier=3, duration=172800s) 4) add canary checks. Will schedule during low-traffic maintenance window if OK.
Marco Eng: config snippet for routing rule (for internal handoff):
```
route_rule {
  match_source_subnet: "203.0.113.0/22"
  prefer_regions: ["eu-west1","asia-southeast1"]
  fallback_ttl: 300
  allowed_models: ["redwood-open-7b-v2","r-instruct-3b"]
}
```
Sam CSM: Bluetrace Sec asked for audit log retention of the demo events for 90 days. Can we enable per-tenant retention?
Li Ops: yes we can set tenant retention to 90 days for logs; will confirm storage implications.
Nina PM: Please capture a short post-demo notes doc so CSM and product have a playbook if they convert. I'll add enablement items and renewal follow-ups.
Ben Oncall: Scheduled the burst policy to auto-disable 2026-06-05T09:05Z and added an alert if p95 latency > 500ms for more than two minutes.
Marco Eng: deployed routing rule to staging, will push to prod after ops confirms allowlist+ticket.
Sam CSM: thanks team — I'll communicate ETA to Bluetrace (aiming for provisioning by 2026-05-28 EOD). :thumbsup:
Li Ops: done — subnet added to allowlist and routing policy attached. Pushing prod changes now.
infra-bot: Deployment to prod succeeded for routing-rule bluetrace-203-0-113. Change-id: chg_20260526_7821.
Sam CSM: Bluetrace Sec confirmed they can reach endpoints via their subnet. Demo date locked. I’ll send enablement checklist to Bluetrace and set up a follow-up renewal call.
Nina PM: noted capture of feedback: ask Bluetrace about tolerance for cross-region failover and preferred model latency targets (p50/p95). I'll add to the post-demo survey.
Sam CSM: closing loop — thanks everyone.
